forcing_mechanism.evidence: Firms under 250 staff get up to EUR 4,500 in aid (aide exceptionnelle) per level 5 apprentice whose contract starts before 1 January 2027.

findable.evidence: The France Travail job ads API and SIRENE both name companies, with NAF code and staff size band fields.

early.evidence: Job ads are live and updated continuously, so apprentice hiring shows before contracts start and before the 1 January 2027 cutoff.

gap_evidence.evidence: No catalogue dataset records signed apprenticeship contracts or aid claims, so no record shows which firms have not taken the aid.

crowding.evidence: For firms under 250 staff, the aid flows from payroll declaration data that existing payroll tools and accountants already file.

list_recipes.filter: codeNAF 55, 56, 47 or 41-43; trancheEffectifEtab 10-249; typeContrat or intitule showing apprenticeship (apprentissage)
list_recipes.gap_evidence: open apprentice ad, so the contract is not yet signed before the 1 January 2027 cutoff
list_recipes.metric: count of open apprentice ads per company
list_recipes.caveat: An open ad shows hiring intent, not a missed claim, and level 3 to 4 apprentices at firms under 250 staff get no aid.

list_recipes.gap_evidence: none in the data; only sector and size eligibility
list_recipes.caveat: SIRENE holds no apprenticeship or aid data, so it only sizes the eligible base.
